sourceNotes.rawContent:
Luxe, bold, and instantly recognisable — our Quilted Grid Chunky Hoop Earrings feature a raised grid-quilt pattern across a wide crescent-shaped hoop, giving a premium designer-inspired look. The structured texture adds dimension and catches light from every angle, making these a standout piece for any outfit.
- 316L Stainless Steel — rust-proof, tarnish-proof & skin-safe
- Gold-plated finish — rich, long-lasting shine
- Waterproof & sweat-resistant — built for everyday wear
- Raised quilted grid texture — luxury designer-inspired look
- Wide crescent silhouette — bold and flattering
- Secure latch-back clasp — lightweight & comfortable all-day
Pairs with: Solid kurtas, co-ords, blazers, sarees, jeans, and monochrome outfits.
Stainless steel is highly durable and water-resistant. Avoid prolonged exposure to harsh chemicals and perfumes.
